body: 2026-10-16. If a profile's own env:/secrets: set ANY variable the login would set or remove (CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN), the login is refused. Why: protects api-billed profiles (e.g. a Moonshot/Kimi profile) whose key would otherwise be unset. Claude oauth-token login sets CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN and removes ANTHROPIC_API_KEY + ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, which would otherwise bill an API key; api-key login is the mirror.
title: A login is refused on a profile whose env sets the same variables
